name: Flank Steak with Parmesan Green Beans
method: skillet/grill steak + boiled dressed green beans
ingredients: 16 ounces fresh or frozen green beans
why: Verified published nutrition on source page: 516 cal / 28g protein / 18g carbs / 38g fat per serving (serves 4) - squarely in the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band. Whole-muscle flank steak, no ground beef, no braise: fits the steak lane. Structurally low-carb (steak + green beans, no rice/potato/bread base). Batch-scales cleanly to 14 (grill/sear steak, boil and dress beans, weigh-and-divide). Every ingredient maps to the Omaha board (honey, parmesan, dijon-mustard, red-wine-vinegar, coconut-aminos, fresh-green-beans, olive-oil, garlic all present) EXCEPT flank steak - board carries sirloin-steak and ribeye-steak but not flank, so it is flagged as a genuine unmapped signature protein for the pricer lane to prove out.
